title: From Python Basics to Trustworthy Research Workflows
utility_use_case: A research team exports instrument results and analysis code into `./artifacts` before sharing a release. Running `bash file-manifest.sh --root ./artifacts` gives the team a sorted JSON inventory to retain alongside release notes or compare with a later export. This helps detect changed bytes or missing eligible files, while leaving the artifact directory untouched. The team still needs separate checks for scientific validity, provenance, hidden files, and any symlinked content because the utility intentionally does not assess those.
